name: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd.
summary:
HIVE Digital Technologies (HIVE) reported a loss of $0.19 per share on revenue of $79.12 million for the fiscal first quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.21 per share on revenue of $80.06 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 9.52% while revenue grew 73.47% on a year-over-year basis.

HIVE is a growth-oriented technology stock in the emergent blockchain industry.
subject: HIVE Digital Technologies Beat Consensus Estimates
